title: Comment: Titanic SHOULDN'T be so preser

metadata.comment_text:
The sight of Titanic, not as a pile of rust but eerily preserved, still gives me chills. The sheer defiance of the deep is astounding.

What aspect of the 1985 discovery surprised you the most? Tell us!

title: Comment: 36CM: Giant Tooth in Desert PR

metadata.comment_text: That immense tooth in the desert is still blowing my mind. To think what else lies buried, waiting to rewrite our understanding of the deep past... makes you wonder if we've even scratched the surface, doesn't it?
That Devonian deep was a nightmare! The way those bone plates interlocked like a living guillotine is just insane. What other ancient deep-sea beasts do you think are lurking for us to discover?

title: Comment: 90m: Ocean X DETECTED the Balt

metadata.comment_text: The Baltic Object truly defies belief. That 300-meter trail is what really gets me – how does something that precise get imprinted on the seafloor? What are your theories?
